m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md, handoff g3_implementer_handoff.md, g2_accept_numbers.json, and fusion.py ~217-229. Verify handoff complete. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + accept numbers + fusion lines loaded; handoff complete

m1-extract-numbers.title: Extract and verify exact numbers from g2_accept_numbers.json
m1-extract-numbers.imperative: Run the verification command from the handoff to extract exact numbers: headline baseline_acc, baseline_easy_acc, alpha=0.5 acc/easy_acc, ceiling_overall; OOS baseline_acc, baseline_easy_acc, alpha=0.5 acc/easy_acc. Record them as evidence. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: exact numbers extracted from JSON and recorded as evidence

check.command: py -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.agent-work/issue-420-quali-anchor-production/g2_accept_numbers.json')); print('HEADLINE baseline:', d['headline']['baseline_acc'], d['headline']['baseline_easy_acc']); print('HEADLINE a=0.5:', d['headline']['alphas']['0.5']['acc'], d['headline']['alphas']['0.5']['easy_acc']); print('HEADLINE ceiling:', d['headline']['ceiling_overall']); print('OOS baseline:', d['oos']['baseline_acc'], d['oos']['baseline_easy_acc']); print('OOS a=0.5:', d['oos']['alphas']['0.5']['acc'], d['oos']['alphas']['0.5']['easy_acc']);"

constraints: do not invent numbers; cite only from the JSON

payload.cmd: py -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.agent-work/issue-420-quali-anchor-production/g2_accept_numbers.json')); print('HEADLINE baseline:', d['headline']['baseline_acc'], d['headline']['baseline_easy_acc']); print('HEADLINE a=0.5:', d['headline']['alphas']['0.5']['acc'], d['headline']['alphas']['0.5']['easy_acc']); print('HEADLINE ceiling:', d['headline']['ceiling_overall']); print('OOS baseline:', d['oos']['baseline_acc'], d['oos']['baseline_easy_acc']); print('OOS a=0.5:', d['oos']['alphas']['0.5']['acc'], d['oos']['alphas']['0.5']['easy_acc']);"

m2-write-section-764.title: Write §7.6.4 in prediction_ceiling_and_priorities.md
m2-write-section-764.imperative: Append new section ### 7.6.4 after §7.6.3 (before §7.7) in docs/evo/prediction_ceiling_and_priorities.md. Must include: production attach point; anchor = min(qs_best_raw, lr_best_raw) and why; acceptance reproduction table with exact numbers; alpha=0.5 rationale; downstream-impact assessment (fusion magnitude/precision-weighting argument, quali_gap_scale, calibration); default-OFF + safe-activation story; config keys and toggle. Must not contradict §7.6.3. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: §7.6.4 written in the file; the file contains '### 7.6.4' heading

check.command: py -c "content=open('docs/evo/prediction_ceiling_and_priorities.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); assert '### 7.6.4' in content, 'missing 7.6.4'; assert '7.6.3' in content, 'missing 7.6.3 (must not be removed)'; print('OK: 7.6.4 present, 7.6.3 present')"

constraints: do NOT alter §7.6.3 or other sections
do NOT touch fusion.py or fusion_rework_findings.md

payload.cmd: py -c "content=open('docs/evo/prediction_ceiling_and_priorities.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); assert '### 7.6.4' in content, 'missing 7.6.4'; assert '7.6.3' in content, 'missing 7.6.3 (must not be removed)'; print('OK: 7.6.4 present, 7.6.3 present')"

m3-fix-toml-comment.title: Fix gold_defaults.toml comment on quali_pace_anchor_enabled
m3-fix-toml-comment.imperative: In configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml, correct the comment '# Quali-head pace anchor (#420): blend the fused quali pi with a practice min-sector ordering.' to accurately state the attach is the per-module race_weekend quali head's pi BEFORE fusion. Keep quali_pace_anchor_enabled = false and quali_pace_anchor_alpha = 0.5 unchanged. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: gold_defaults.toml enabled=false, alpha=0.5, comment corrected (does not say 'fused quali pi')

check.command: py -c "content=open('configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml',encoding='utf-8').read(); assert 'quali_pace_anchor_enabled = false' in content; assert 'quali_pace_anchor_alpha = 0.5' in content; assert 'fused quali pi' not in content, 'stale fused-pi comment still present'; print('OK: enabled=false, alpha=0.5, stale comment removed')"

constraints: do NOT change enabled or alpha values
